questions.question: Which book by Kiran Desai is a tale of a young man named Sampath Chawla?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Hullabaloo in the Guava Orchard**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hullabaloo in the Guava Orchard** is a novel by** Kiran Desai.**
 
• It is her first book and won the top prize for the** Betty Trask Awards in 1998.**
 
• The book deals with a** fictitious small town called Shahkot in North India.**
 
• The story tells about **Sampath Chawla,** who just wants to be left alone, is forced into being a holy man in spite of himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Selection Day** is a** 2016 sports fiction novel** written by Booker Prize winner** Aravind Adiga.**
 
• **An Equal Music** (1999) is a novel by **Vikram Seth.**
 
• **It Happens for a Reason** is a novel written by **Preeti Shenoy.**

questions.question: Which of the following Indian National political parties is reputed to be one of the oldest, founded in 1885 and has experienced many splits?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Indian National Congress (INC)**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian National Congress** was founded in Bombay in** December 1885.**
 
• The** Indian National Congress (INC)** has seen a **steady number of splits and breakaway factions**. 
 
• Some of the breakaway organizations have thrived as independent parties, some have become defunct, while others have merged with the parent party or other political parties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Communist Party of India — Marxist (CPI-M)** emerged from a split from the Communist Party of India in 1964. 
 
• The **CPI(M)** was formed in** Calcutta from 31 October to 7 November 1964**.
 
• The **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)** was formed on **25 May 1999, by Sharad Pawar, P. A. Sangma, and Tariq Anwar after they were expelled from the Indian National Congress (INC) on 20 May 1999.**
 
• The** Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) **was **founded in 1984 by Kanshi Ram.**

questions.question: Ganymede is by far the largest moon in our solar system orbits around the planet _______.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is__** Jupiter**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jupiter's moon Ganymede** is the **largest satellite in the solar system**. 
 
• The **satellite is even larger than Mercury and Pluto**, and only slightly **smaller than Mars**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Jupiter** is the **fifth planet from the Sun and the largest in the Solar System**. 
 
• It is a gas giant with a mass one-thousandth that of the Sun.
 
• **Jupiter** currently has **92 known satellites.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uranus** currently has** 27 known satellites**.
 
• **Neptune** has **14 known moons**, which are named for minor water deities in Greek mythology.
 
• **Saturn **has 146** moons**.

questions.question: The formula of Acetonitrile is _______
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**CH₃CN**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acetonitrile** is a **chemical compound** with the formula **CH₃CN.**__
 
• It is produced mainly as a byproduct of **acrylonitrile manufacture. **
 
• It is used as a **polar aprotic solvent in organic synthesis and in the purification of butadiene**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Methyl isocyanate (MIC)** is an organic compound with the molecular formula **CH₃NCO.**
 
• **Cyanogen** is the chemical compound with the formula** (CN)₂.**
 
• It is a colorless, toxic gas with a pungent odor.
 
• **Acrylonitrile** is an organic compound with the formula **CH₂CHCN. **
 
• It is a colorless volatile liquid.
 
• It has a pungent odor of garlic or onions.

questions.question: ______ is an important copper ore mineral
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Chalcocite**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chalcocite **is one of the most important **ores of copper.**
 
• **Chalcocite (Cu2S)** belongs to a **group of sulfide minerals formed at relatively low temperatures.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Galena**

 
• Galena, also called lead glance, is the natural mineral form of lead(II) sulfide (PbS).
 
• It is the most important ore of lead and an important source of silver.

**Cassiterite**

 
• Cassiterite, also called tinstone, is the major ore of tin.

**Cinnabar**

 
• Cinnabar is an important ore of mercury.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers flows into the Arabian Sea?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is__** Mahi**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahi** rises in Minda Village, in sardarpur district **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• After **flowing through the Vagad region of Rajasthan, enters Gujarat and flows into the Arabian Sea.**
 
• It is one of only three major rivers in peninsular India that runs from east to west along with the Tapti River and the Narmada River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Krishna**

 
• 
 It originates near** Mahabaleshwar (Satara) in Maharashtra.**
 
 
• 
 It runs from **four states Maharashtra (303 km), North Karnataka (480 km), and the rest of its 1300 km journey in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh before It empties into the Bay of Bengal.**
 
 
• 
 **Tributaries:** Tungabhadra, Mallaprabha, Koyna, Bhima, Ghataprabha, Yerla, Warna, Dindi, Musi and Dudhganga.
 

**Penna**

 
• The **Penna rises in the Nandi Hills in Chikkaballapur District of Karnataka.**
 
• It runs **north and east through the states of Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh to empty into the Bay of Bengal.**

**Rushikulya**

 
• The **Rushikulya River is one of the major rivers in the state of Odisha.**
 
• It has a **catchment area in the districts of Kandhamal and Ganjam of Odisha**.
 
• It meets the** Bay of Bengal at Purina Bandha in Ganjam.**

questions.question: Who did Mughal Emperor Babur defeat in the Battle of Ghagra in 1529?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Mahmud Lodi**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Battle of Ghaghra** was fought in **1529. **
 
• The** battle of Ghagra **was fought between the Afgan king **Mahmud Lodi** and the Mughal emperor** Babur.**
 
• Lodi was supported by the **Rajput kings of India**.
 
• **Mahmud Lodi **was defeated in the** battle, and Babur extended his frontier from the Oxus River in the west to the Ghagra River in the east and from the Himalayas to Gwalior.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yusuf Adil Shah **was the founder of the **Adil Shahi dynasty that ruled the Sultanate of Bijapur for nearly two centuries.**
 
• **Dilawar Khan Ghori** was **governor of the Malwa province of central India during the decline of the Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• **Qasim Barid I **was **prime-minister of the Bahmani sultanate and the founder of the Bidar Sultanate.**

questions.question: The GDP growth rate for the fiscal year 2017-2018 was pegged at _______ by the Economic Survey report 2017-18.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6.75%**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Economy survey 2017-2018** was authored by the **chief economic adviser in the finance ministry Arvind Subramaniam.**
 
• The real **GDP growth projections for 2017-18 **were expected to be around **6.75%.**
 
• The survey also stated that the** Major reforms initiated by the government would take the growth rate to 7-7.5% in 2018-19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Economic Survey is a detailed report of the country's economic performance during the past year.
 
• The Economic Survey also offers glimpses into the current state of the economy, and occasional insights into the economic outlook. 
 
• The Economic Survey is prepared under the guidance of the **Chief Economic Advisor.**
 
• It is presented in both the houses of Parliament, a day before the announcement of the Union Budget.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: The Supreme Court was established at Fort William in _______ as the Apex Court in 1774.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kolkata**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The regulating act of 1773 **established a supreme court at** Fort William, Calcutta**.
 
• This **Supreme Court consisted of one Chief Justice and three other regular judges or Puisne Judges.**
 
• **Sir Elijah Imphey **was the **first Chief Justice of this Supreme Court.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**The regulating act of 1773 **

 
• It was the **first step taken by the British Government to control and regulate the affairs of the East India Company in India.**
 
• It recognized, for the** first time, the political and administrative functions of the Company.**
 
• It designated the **Governor of Bengal as the ‘Governor-General of Bengal’ and created an Executive Council of four members to assist him.**
 
• The first such **Governor-General** was Lord **Warren Hastings.**
